title: a user build is validated against the launching project's allowlists: invalid here it is skipped with a warning, and launching it is rejected
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). Every build of every layer is validated against the project that launches it (its jitso/jitso.yaml and its instruction route ids), not against the folder the build lives in. A user build whose model is not in this project's allowlist is skipped by build list with one stderr warning (`jitso: warning: skipped build user <path>: <problems>`), `launch --build <id>` is rejected (exit 2) with the same problems, and the project's own builds keep working with a clean stderr.

stderr.contains: jitso: warning: skipped build user ~/.jitso/builds/future.yaml: model "claude-future-9" is not in the allowlist
JITSO REJECTED: build "future" from user ~/.jitso/builds/future.yaml is invalid here: model "claude-future-9" is not in the allowlist
